systems.name: Ticket router A
systems.label: SYNTHETIC
systems.intended_use: Route synthetic support tickets to one of two queues for human triage.
out_of_scope: Any decision about a real person.
Use on data that is not synthetic.
Fully automatic routing with no human review.
known_limitations: Evaluated on seeded synthetic data only.
Recall is measured on the positive class only.
systems.human_oversight: A named reviewer inspects a sample of routed tickets each week and can switch the router off.
systems.design_rationale: A single threshold classifier was chosen as the simplest baseline that can be audited.
